name: 部屋と寝具の数量条件
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0010 部屋と寝具の数量条件.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: image1 ORIGINAL Airbnb screenshot controls circular plus/minus glyph geometry, optical stroke weight, alignment, spacing and disabled-state details. Relevant source x71 y1279 width1030 height604, Rooms and beds ONLY. Image2 rough mock is secondary Japanese copy/layout; its minus controls look too active. Image3 approved bus is STYLE ONLY.
Exact content: heading "部屋と寝具"; exactly3rows labeled "寝室", "ベッド", "浴室". Each row has an original circular MINUS button, central "指定なし", and original circular PLUS button at right, in that order. No numerical count, added label or row.
Preserve actual visible state: ALL three minus buttons DISABLED with very pale gray strokes/borders and low-emphasis minus; ALL three plus buttons AVAILABLE with clear slate #526173 plus and neutral outline. Central values all "指定なし" in ink. Source circles are clean symmetric thin outline, centered simple horizontal minus / symmetric plus, no malformed glyph, fill, shadowed glossybutton or extraicon. Align plus/minus/value columns vertically across all3rows and labels left.
Accent decision: original has no chromatic accent or selectedstate; disabled-vs-available is conveyed through neutral optical weight and pale state. Keep this useful difference. Omit colored accent; no arbitrary green/blue incrementbuttons or mint fill. Primary brandfilled action does not exist in this component.
Purewhite #FFFFFF canvas/card, one rounded white card, fine neutral border and faint downward shadow; compact readable rows with no extra rowdividers (source has none). Preserve Japanese Meiryo heading Bold20/28; rowlabels Regular14/24, values Regular12/16, tracking0, normal delicate body strokes. Do not make all textbold. Flat frontal high-resolution landscape4:3 with modest white margins. Exclude original price chart, sheet header/close, amenities, bottom buttons, logo/device. No extra features or text.
reviewNotes: 原参照優先の円形操作と無効状態を保持。寝室・ベッド・浴室の3行、指定なし3個、非常に薄い無効マイナスとスレートの使用可能プラスを視認。原に色の役割がないため色追加なし、ミント面や不要な区切りなし。白カード、整列、欠けなし。静止画像エージェントレビューのみ、所有者承認・厳密フォント一致・実際の操作・編集可能性・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
